content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the kaunas district court the court decided to dissolve a marriage and awarded the applicant an audi vehicle and the defendant a passat vehicle the defendant was also declared personally liable for credit claims from a company called g the court mentioned the division of 100 shares in a company called uab x but did not specify who was awarded these shares the text discusses two articles from the civil code related to matrimonial property and establishing asset balance the applicant is seeking the dissolution of the marriage the establishment of the childs residence with her and monthly maintenance payments from the father for the childs support the father partially accepts the application and claims that the breakdown of the marriage was the mothers fault the court will decide on the dissolution of the marriage and the division of property and debts the costs of the proceedings will be allocated between the parties the court has approved the dissolution of the marriage and awarded the applicant ownership of an audi vehicle the defendant has been awarded ownership of another vehicle the court has also determined the residence of the minor child and ordered the defendant to pay the costs of the proceedings the remaining amended application has been dismissed
